# Repository Orientation for LLMs

This repository follows standard project layout guidelines:
- Documentation files: README.md, TODO.md, CHANGELOG.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, CITATION.cff.
- Configuration: .editorconfig, .gitattributes, .gitignore, .prettierrc, .prettierignore, .markdownlint.json, .markdownlintignore, cspell.json.
- GitHub governance & AI steering: .github/copilot-instructions.md, .github/dependabot.yml, .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/, .github/DISCUSSION_TEMPLATE/.
- Workflows: .github/workflows for CI/CD (format.yml, spellcheck.yml, ps-analyzer.yml, gitleaks.yml, cleanup.yml).
- Pre-push validation standard: en-GB spelling enforced via `npx cspell "**"` (with alphabetically sorted `words` in `cspell.json`) and formatting enforced via `npx prettier --check "."`.
